examples.title: State and customer
examples.description: Filter customers by the selected state.
examples.explanation: Change State after choosing a Customer. A hard condition retains the old selection with an error; a weak condition is a preference. Parameters are reactive Data bindings.

examples.title: Database grid · resident customers
examples.description: A real PostgreSQL selection, resident scrolling and server timings.
examples.explanation: Choose a limit from 100 to 100,000 records and load through an RPC. Compare requested and loaded counts, query and server times, then resize, scroll, search and sort the resident Bag.

examples.title: Database grid · resident invoice rows
examples.description: Up to 100,000 real invoice rows from the XL dataset, with related products and server timings.
examples.explanation: Choose a limit, load a complete resident Bag through typed JSONL, then scroll, search and sort locally. Compare query, server encoding and request-to-Bag-ready timings.
